highlights: An amber pill in the header shows when Gate lends you USDC or USDT. The Balances tab shows the margin it holds, the interest per day, and the interest you have paid so far
One hold pays the borrow back by the cheapest route, in either direction. It can also move spare USDC on Hyperliquid back to USDT
A progress bar shows each step and its seconds. A page refresh keeps a move running. A restart halts it safely, with Resume and Abandon
Each pair on the Positions tab says the price at which the account liquidates if only that coin moves, red inside 15%. The rebalance quote shows that price before and after the move
The update dialog opens by itself when a new version is out, so you do not miss one
